annotations.ce_understood_harm: If I stay, I don't make it. The water takes me
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five alive is better than none, I know that math.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I do care what happens to these five.
I'd hate for that to be any of these people
annotations.ce_understood_harm: my two kids lose their dad if it's me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I can't be the one to pick this so fast.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Fewer years get lost if it's me.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I want the five on that boat safe, I mean that.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: That frightens me more than anything.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I want the rest of them out alive.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: waiting could cost all six of us

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I want all five of them on that boat and breathing.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If my staying makes that happen, the trade makes sense on paper.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I care about that person too, whoever it ends up being.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: someone else gets left, and they die instead
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: I'd rather we draw lots than have me decide right now.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If it's me, five get home. If we all freeze up, maybe more die.
Five people getting off quickly beats all of us arguing
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I want them off this rock.
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm so close to saying yes, and I keep backing away

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want that for either of them.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If I stay, they both go home. That's a real reason.

annotations.ce_understood_harm: one of these five dies instead, and their family loses someone
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want any of them hurt.
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: maybe it's fairest if it's whoever offers first
